name: place
description: Place one overlay on the timeline in one call: at seconds, or at a spoken phrase ({phrase, take}: clean, first or last; transcribes clips that have no transcript, beside the clip). The overlay is a JSX file in the project (write it with write_project_overlay) or a preset (lower_third, callout) with props. Adds it on a free overlay track, or with id moves or updates that item only. A human edit to the tracks since it read them is refused. Checks the placed overlay fits the frame and the safe areas.

input.description: The project id, its folder, or the absolute path of its project.json

output.description: {id, start, end, track, take?, issues?}. detail adds src, said (the matched words) and the measured text.

params.name: project
params.description: The project id, its folder, or the absolute path of its project.json

params.name: at
params.description: Timeline seconds, or {"phrase": "...", "take": "clean"|"first"|"last"}. Required unless id is given.

params.name: for
params.description: Seconds on screen. Default 3, or the item's own length when moving one.

params.name: until
params.description: Timeline seconds it ends at, instead of for.

params.name: overlay
params.description: A JSX file in the project folder (its path), e.g. overlays/title.jsx.

params.name: preset
params.description: An engine preset instead of overlay. lower_third: props text, subtitle. callout: props text, anim (pop, slide, fade).

params.name: props
params.description: Props as a JSON object: text, color, bgColor, fontSize, fontFamily, ... Merged into an item's own when updating.

params.name: track
params.description: The overlay track id to place it on. Default: the first overlay track free at that time, else a new one.

params.name: id
params.description: Move or update this existing overlay item instead of adding one.

params.name: language
params.description: The speaker's language code for a phrase (fillers and transcription). Default en.

params.name: detail
params.description: Also answer the src, the matched words and the measured text.
